title: EnterPlanMode Metadata — Tier 2 (Partial)
description: Partial metadata for the EnterPlanMode tool. Signals the start of a planning phase. decision.signal_type='pre_decision' — the plan mode entry IS the transition into a decision context. koth domain is typically 'planning'.

notes.decision.signal_type: 'pre_decision' — entering plan mode precedes the actual decision (ExitPlanMode).
notes.koth.outcome_signal: Set on ExitPlanMode (the paired tool), not here. Set to 'pending' at EnterPlanMode time.
